name: lapland-snowy-window-seductress
image_vibe: cozy winter, playful, inviting, soft natural glow

prompt.project_info: Detailed photorealistic 2:3 vertical lifestyle glamour portrait in a bright modern indoor room, with realistic fabric and skin texture and a cozy winter-lodge atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: One adult woman with fair skin, long dark-blonde hair parted in the middle and falling naturally over her shoulders, subtle makeup with defined brows and soft pink lips, and a gentle playful smile with direct gaze at camera. She has a curvy figure and wears large red fluffy earmuffs, a black lace choker, a thin gold necklace with a small key-shaped pendant, a thin gold bracelet on the right wrist, and long natural manicured nails.
prompt.composition_elements: The subject sits casually on a light wooden windowsill or floor ledge, body angled slightly toward the camera, knees bent with legs together and one foot tucked under. Her right hand rests lightly on the sill for support and her left arm is relaxed. Frame a centered medium full-body vertical portrait from mid-thigh up while including the boots, with the window view framing the right side. She wears a lime-green long-sleeve form-fitting bodysuit or top with a flattering neckline, yellow thigh-high socks with three white horizontal stripes near the top, tan suede winter boots with thick white fur lining, red laces, and rugged soles, plus oversized yellow plush earmuffs.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight streams from the side through a large floor-to-ceiling window, creating gentle warm highlights on the skin and hair and subtle cool blue tones from the snowy view. Keep the atmosphere clean, fresh, intimate, inviting, and cozy without harsh shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: 2:3 vertical portrait orientation, professional lifestyle glamour photography, high resolution, sharp focus on fabric textures and skin detail, realistic rendering. Use a palette led by lime green, pale skin, warm wood, cool whites, and snowy blues.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 2:3 vertical lifestyle glamour portrait of one adult woman seated casually on a light wooden windowsill in a bright modern winter room. Fair skin, long dark-blonde center-parted hair, defined brows, soft pink lips, gentle playful smile and direct camera gaze. Curvy figure in a lime-green long-sleeve form-fitting bodysuit with a flattering neckline, yellow thigh-high socks with three white stripes, tan suede winter boots with thick white fur lining, red laces and rugged soles, oversized yellow plush earmuffs, black lace choker, gold key pendant and bracelet. Large floor-to-ceiling window reveals a snowy Lapland landscape with bare birch trees, snow-covered ground, an arctic fox and distant hills under a partly cloudy sky. Soft side daylight, warm highlights, cool blue snow tones, light wooden floor and sill, plain light-gray walls, cozy winter cabin mood, realistic fabric and skin detail, sharp focus.
